title: Tooling: accelerate exact quadratic-affine witness replay
head: 3603d8d9184995ae1cc67c0f5e01f02f3a1d634e
body:
The historical quadratic-affine audit constructs its largest minor through pairwise Hermitian products. This optional adapter computes the same complete rows with carry-safe integer lanes. **Tooling improvement; no new kappa or new negative result.**

Three alternating fresh-process pairs on CPython 3.14.2/macOS arm64 measured median complete-audit wall time **73.411 s → 10.959 s (6.70x)**. All six certificates match the frozen original byte for byte. This includes imports, source admission, all twelve witnesses, rational span controls, certificate comparison and output; it is not a whole-repository or selected-frontier speedup. Raw samples and the overlapping preliminary probe are disclosed separately.

Only `research/quadratic-affine-packed/` is added. The original checker, default commands, selected frontier and `upstream/` remain unchanged. The README supplies the signed-lane, zero-detection and compaction arguments, source pins, provenance and limits.

## Reproduce and validation

```sh
python3 -I -B research/quadratic-affine-packed/verify.py
```

Expected final line: `PASS_QUADRATIC_AFFINE_DIFFERENTIAL all_frozen_rows_equal=true cases=12`.

- **14,662 full rows / 161,333,572 declared matrix entries** directly compared against the original pairwise calculation, with unchanged ordered binary elimination, digests, rational span checks and complete certificate.
- **19 test groups pass:** 12 packed-arithmetic tests, three source/CLI guard tests and four unchanged original tests. A literal integer-component oracle covers all 125 three-coordinate phase vectors, all 60 small Gaussian labels, seeded cases at every dimension 1–32, signed extremes and lane boundaries.
- Meaningful controls detect missing conjugation, ignored imaginary parts, omitted diagonal entries, adjacent-lane borrowing, dependent rows, source/fixture/certificate corruption, disabled assertions and reused output. The omitted-diagonal example retains the same rank but changes its digest.
- Isolated minimal replay from an unrelated directory and a path with spaces passes, preserving every copied file. Selected-record/source-inventory verification and staged whitespace validation pass.
- Full `make verify`, selected cold supplier replay, Lean and remote Linux CI were not run or claimed for this optional adapter.

The existing negative result concerns only twelve specified full-orthogonality matrices. Other supported matrices, subfamilies and compilers remain outside it. All inherited all-size, realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations retain their scope.

## Pins, assignment and credit

Historical source: `d55bcd62ceb8f322bcf311a5a66e94c3ac7724f0`; upstream: `adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`. `SOURCES.json` pins all 37 predecessor files consumed by the replay. At this base the selected conditional kappa remains #626/#543's **0.001635527380375392**.

OS-random seed **92**, verification-engineering track. Three candidates and scope are recorded in `SELECTION.json`; there was no pinned coordination issue, so the claim is local. Final overlap review covered 565 open PRs through #746, then fresh arrivals through #748. PR154's unchanged quadratic-affine hotspot is credited; the newer geometry, Gram, owner-mask, cyclic-inverse and streaming tools concern distinct kernels. No pending code is imported.

Credit **Douglas R. Colkitt** for the original families, witnesses and audit, and **eumemic/PR154** for the profiling lead. Prepared by **Curtis Dransfield (@Curtis-D) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including a separate scoped AI arithmetic reviewer and test author. No independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0; predecessor attribution remains intact.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
